scope: Read-only native attribution and current Source inspection; two evidence files only.

target.verification: Every bsp.py ghidra query invokes Client.verify; verifies project_name, program_path, language and image_base before querying. No GPR mutation.

loader_to_first_array.index: 0, incremented after each Lua iteration, no count cap
loader_to_first_array.published_value: current result from sample cache 00a83fd0; current cache creator/profile still governs the sample

objective_playback.output_address: 008dd53e computes stack address; 008dd542 pushes it; result is [esp+0xc] after return
objective_playback.qualification: Complete-normal-body statement for this receiver in this function; not a whole-program proof that the second array is never written.

tracked_sound.caller_output: hidden output pointer supplied by 008dd460 points to its stack, not GlobalConfig
tracked_sound.current_kind_1_profile: not traced; it cannot close the missing GlobalConfig publication edge

conditional_nonspatial_profile.condition: kind0 and manager current table is 00d5b000 or 00d5b44c; successful native 00a7f640 factory

unchecked_index_boundary.result: Can overwrite second slots with samples; not a channel publication contract
unchecked_index_boundary.explanation: Bytes after the two established sample virtual entries begin an adjacent literal; no sound-stop entry is established there. Unchecked arithmetic does not establish a valid effect payload.

remaining_edge.from: An actual nonnull playback/effect payload producer
missing: native publication instruction and input domain
actual published object layout and current profile at stop/release
raw Source producer/storage and non-decrementing current-profile final release
rejected_shortcuts: invent a store of the 00a7f640 result
use projected SoundChannelRuntime objects raw at +4
call logical release after GlobalConfig already decremented
admit empty slots or no-op callbacks
treat sample-array overflow as a valid sound profile

consumer_contract.stop: 008dbdf5 calls captured second object current virtual+8 with stack flag0 and ECX=object
consumer_contract.release_reload: 008dbdf7 reloads the second slot after stop
consumer_contract.zero: current virtual+0 with ECX=object, no stack argument, only when count becomes zero
consumer_contract.conditional_channel_zero_path: D5ABF8+0 -> BD30E0 -> current vtable+4 with flag1 -> A7D5A0; BD30E0 does not decrement
consumer_contract.slot_cleanup: clear after callbacks; later reverse destructor passes remain required
